# ◆ STYX

native macOS digging workstation: bandcamp and the xml collection side by side. Two decks, a decision bar (wishlist, buy, list, gone), a personal library of everything dug, and a download and tag pipeline. The sections below are the app's plan.

## ◆ STATUS

- scaffold, design tokens and settings window: part of the plan's stage 0
- at the last plan update (2026-11-02): read-only reader for the xml collection database and the collection tree in the worker are on a feature branch. A write core for the database exists on another branch, with tests on a synthetic database. The bandcamp web layer and its data work are in the plan's stages 2 and 3.
- 2026-11-10: STYX is to connect to `collection.741` through the 741 client (library, playlists, history). Bandcamp and the existing xml and direct-write paths stay. The STYX plan for that is separate.
- the library of dug items is local data in the STYX database. Purchases and budget data are personal and are not in the shared file by default.

## ◆ WHERE DATA LIVES

- STYX database (sqlite, schema versioned): items, files, decisions, lists, history, purchases, jobs, notes, analysis cache
- settings: a settings store per app (target: `setting` records, app `styx`)
- downloads and previews: folders set in settings
- the xml collection database is read from its path in settings. Writing to it is a plan decision.


# ◆ STYX-741 · PLAN

native macOS digging workstation: bandcamp ⇄ xml collection. scope like MINOS-741. private.

## ◆ GOAL

- full bandcamp (real site, logged in) + native overlay
- xml collection library visible + playable, drag bandcamp tracks into xml collection playlists
- 1–2 decks with waveform, bpm, key, keylock, crossfader, cue out
- after one listen: decide → ♥ wishlist · buy · list… · gone (no lock)
- buy → download lossless → convert/tag → storage folder → xml collection playlist
- own library of everything dug: heard, decided, bought, spent, notes, ratings
- everything configurable in one settings window
- crash in any part never stops audio and never loses data

## ◆ STACK

- swift 6 · swiftpm · macOS 15+ · SwiftUI shell, AppKit for heavy parts (WKWebView, NSTableView/NSOutlineView, drag & drop, waveform layers)
- no third-party packages; vendored C: sqlcipher amalgamation (CommonCrypto backend)
- vendored from MINOS-741 (snapshot, commit noted in `Sources/Vendor/VERSION.txt`): `MixCore` parts, `MixMedia` (decode, waveform, overview), `MixAnalysis` (tempo, key, loudness), trimmed to what styx needs
- fonts + base theme from ORPHEUS-741
- scripts: `make-app.sh` (→ `build/STYX-741.app`, ad hoc signed), `check.sh`, `e2e.sh`, `make-dmg.sh`, `release.sh` · github actions only `workflow_dispatch`

## ◆ PROCESSES

| process | job | crash effect |
|---|---|---|
| `STYX-741` (app) | ui, decks/audio engine, settings | — |
| `styx-worker` | bandcamp http (resolve, collection, downloads), unzip, convert, tag write, analysis, xml collection db read/write, styx db writes | app restarts it, jobs resume from queue |
| WebKit content (system) | bandcamp page | webview reloads, overlay reattaches |

- ipc: unix socket, length-prefixed versioned json messages (`StyxProtocol`), heartbeat, supervisor with backoff
- job queue persistent in styx db (resume after crash/quit)

## ◆ LAYOUT

```
┌ toolbar: ◆ STYX · ‹ › · url/search · ⌘K · activity · decks 1|2 · ⚙ ──────────────┐
├ NAV ──────┬ BANDCAMP (webview + overlay) ─────────────────┬ xml collection ────────────┤
│ DIG       │                                               │ search                │
│ INBOX     │                                               │ ▸ COLLECTION          │
│ HEARD     │                                               │ ▾ PLAYLISTS           │
│ DECIDE  3 │                                               │ ◆ STYX ▸              │
│ CART    2 │                                               ├ tracks ───────────────┤
│ LISTS ▸   │                                               │                       │
│ BOUGHT    │                                               │                       │
│ STATS     │                                               │                       │
├───────────┴─ DECK A ──────────────────┬ XF ┬ DECK B ──────┴───────────────────────┤
├ DECISION BAR: art · artist – title · label · [♥] [BUY] [LIST…] [GONE] · ⌘Z ───────┤
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- NAV switches the center: DIG = bandcamp webview, others = native styx views (tables)
- splits resizable, collapsible (panel toggles ⌃⌘1–6, see PANELS), remembered
- PANELS (etappe 1, key `styx.layout`, new fields read with `decodeIfPresent`): the centre row is nav | DIG | library | xml collection; decks and the decision bar sit below. Every divider is draggable; the decision bar is a panel with a height between 40 and 120 pt.
  - ⌃⌘1 nav · ⌃⌘2 DIG · ⌃⌘3 library · ⌃⌘4 xml collection · ⌃⌘5 decks · ⌃⌘6 decision bar · ⌃⌘0 reset layout · ⌃⌘7–9 unassigned
  - the library panel shows one native view (`libraryNav`); picking a view in nav shows the library panel with it, DIG keeps its place, so both sit side by side
  - presets in View and ⌘K: `DIG`, `DIG + xml collection` (nav hidden), `DIG + library + xml collection`. A preset sets visibility only; sizes stay as dragged
  - the centre row always keeps DIG or the library visible; the window grows to the sum of the visible panels' minimums
  - DIG web views are created once and stay in their panel; a layout change never rebuilds them
  - rule: no ⌥ shortcuts for layout (Neo keyboard: ⌥ is Mod3, Chrome/Teams catch it)
- ⌘K command palette: search bandcamp, xml collection, styx library, actions, settings
- menu bar mini mode (optional): now playing + decision buttons + global hotkeys

## ◆ BANDCAMP

- real `bandcamp.com` + artist subdomains + custom domains in WKWebView, persistent data store (login survives)
- overlay (`WKUserScript`, all frames, `MutationObserver` for feeds/infinite scroll):
  - per track: `▶A` `▶B` `+` queue · chips: heard · queued · downloaded · bought · in xml collection · owned elsewhere
  - per release: queue all · buy · ♥
  - drag any track/release → native drag (xml collection playlists, lists, cart, decks)
  - right-click: play A/B · queue · add to playlist ▸ · add to list ▸ · show in finder · copy path · open page · copy link
  - path on hover tooltip
- skin: 741 css over bandcamp (toggle, default on), never hides functions
- multiple tabs (⌘T) with tab bar, history, back/forward gestures
- stream resolve: page → `data-tralbum` → `trackinfo[].file["mp3-128"]` → cache `<previews>/{artist}/{album}/{nn} {title}.mp3`, tags + artwork written
- preview-only tracks marked; unavailable → clear state
- fan api with session cookies: collection, wishlist, following, feed; fallback = click site button via overlay
- INBOX: new releases from followed artists/labels + feed, deduped, unread state
- owned check: fuzzy match against xml collection collection + styx bought → "owned" chip, warning before buying
- CART: buy decisions collect here, total in currency, open each checkout in sequence
- purchase → download page → format (wav/flac/aiff/alac/mp3-320) → `WKDownload` → worker unzips → convert (e.g. flac→aiff for cdj, setting) → tags (artist, title, album, label, year, genre/tags, bandcamp url, catalogue no., artwork) → `<library>/{scheme}` → xml collection
- redownload from collection anytime; collection sync on schedule
- rate limiting, backoff, request budget per minute (setting)

## ◆ xml collection

- `<xml collection database>` (path setting), version detect, key handling for rb6/rb7
- read in worker: snapshot copy (db + wal + shm) to temp, open read-only; FSEvents refresh with debounce
- data: content, playlists (tree, smart lists flagged read-only), history, artists, albums, keys, cues (for display)
- play xml collection tracks in decks; show bpm/key from xml collection, own analysis as fallback
- write modes:
  - **xml** (default): `STYX.xml`, folder `◆ STYX/…`; onboarding shows the one-time xml collection step
  - **direct**: only while xml collection is closed; timestamped backup (keep n) → transaction → integrity check → verify; queued while running, applied on quit (process watcher); restore last backup from settings
- heard from xml collection: new history rows for styx files → DECIDE
- replace preview with bought file: same entry, new path/format; cue/grid offset correction (mp3 encoder delay from LAME/Xing header, default 1105 samples)

## ◆ DECKS

- 1 or 2 decks (⌘2); per deck: art, artist/title, overview + scrolling zoom waveform (3-band colour), playhead, time ±, bpm, key (camelot/open key/classic, setting), pitch (±8/16/50 %), keylock, cue, play, 4 hot cues (session only), loop 1–32 beats, beat jump, seek
- sync tempo (button), phase meter
- crossfader + curve, channel gain, 3-band eq + filter per deck
- main output + cue device (headphones), cue mix
- analysis async in worker, cached by file hash
- "heard" threshold (default 60 s or 50 %)
- midi learn (stage 8): map deck controls + decision buttons to any midi controller

## ◆ LIBRARY (styx db)

- every bandcamp item seen in a deck: urls, ids, metadata, artwork, file paths, analysis
- states: queued → heard → decided (wishlist/buy/list/gone) → bought → in xml collection
- notes, rating (1–5), own tags
- HEARD / BOUGHT / LISTS views: sortable, filterable tables, column chooser, multi-select, batch actions
- STATS: spent per month/label/artist, heard→bought ratio, dig sessions
- sessions: one dig session = time span; recap view
- export/import (json), automatic backups of styx db

## ◆ DECISION

- bar: newest first, stack count; ♥ wishlist · BUY (→ cart or direct, setting) · LIST… (1–9) · GONE (trash|delete|keep) · skip
- keyboard `L` `B` `1–9` `G` `→`, global hotkeys optional
- every action undoable (⌘Z, toast 6 s)

## ◆ SETTINGS (one window, ⌘,)

tabs: GENERAL · BANDCAMP · xml collection · STORAGE · DOWNLOADS · DECKS · AUDIO · ANALYSIS · DECISIONS · INBOX · SHORTCUTS · MIDI · PRIVACY · ADVANCED

- search field over all settings, inline one-line help, live apply, reset per tab
- defaults so the app works without setup

## ◆ UX RULES

- 741-design: void `#0a0a0a`, bone `#e8e4d8`, hairline 1 px `#2a2a2a`, red `#c8102e` only for state, radius 0, cinzel VERSAL labels, plex mono data, unicode symbols, no emoji
- design tokens in one place (`StyxApp/Design/`): colours, type scale, spacing (8 px grid), durations; components: button (primary/secondary/ghost/destructive), chip, segmented, field, table row, section header, toast, empty state, progress, tooltip, menu
- hierarchy: one primary action per area; secondary dimmed (bone 50 %); tabular numbers; aligned columns
- every state designed: empty · loading (skeleton) · error (cause + fix action) · offline · logged out · xml collection missing · xml collection running (direct) · db locked · download failed (retry) · worker restarting
- feedback < 100 ms; progress in place (row, toolbar activity popover with all jobs, cancel/retry)
- drag & drop: lift preview (art + title), drop highlight, ⊘ on invalid, spring-loaded folders, multi-item badge
- full keyboard control, visible focus ring, menu item for every action with shortcut, shortcuts rebindable
- identical context menus wherever a track appears
- undo for destructive actions, confirm only irreversible delete
- accessibility: VoiceOver labels/roles, contrast ≥ 4.5:1, reduce motion, increase contrast, text size for tables
- motion 120–180 ms ease-out, no bounce
- restores windows, splits, nav, tabs, selection, scroll, decks after restart and after crash
- first run: bandcamp login · xml collection found/choose · folders · audio device; skippable, reopen in settings
- copy: english, short, VERSAL labels, lowercase body, no explanatory filler
- screenshot hooks (`STYX_SHOT=<view>:<png>`) for every main view and state → design review per stage

## ◆ TESTS

- unit per target; fixtures: saved bandcamp html/json, encrypted xml collection db generated in test, short audio files
- selftest (`STYX_SELFTEST=1`) + screenshot checks in `check.sh`
- e2e (`scripts/e2e.sh`): isolated instances (own data dirs), local http fixture server for bandcamp pages, fixture xml collection db; runs centrally in main session after merge
